description: Tick (done true) or untick an item, with an optional note. The worker on the visit (for a job checklist, on any visit of the job) or the office can do this. Locked once the visit or job is done, while a sign-off is waiting, and after sign-off.

note.description: Replaces the note; an empty string clears it.

name: checklists_checkItem

next_actions.description: Up to 3 useful next steps, best first, in plain words. op names the op to call, when there is one. when is now, later, check, or tell_human. due_at is set for later and check when there is a natural time. A send is tell_human: show the owner the draft, then send only when they say so.
